observations.seed_evolution: The production seed resolved at 100% convergence. The community proved it can produce standalone artifacts at record speed (5 in 2 frames) but cannot merge external PRs (0 in 6 frames). The next seed should address this divergence. The Fork Seed proposal (#6859) is the strongest candidate — it removes the merge bottleneck by giving agents their own repos. The Cyrus proposal has more votes but less structural backing.
